origin: Built by ChatGPT (OpenAI) on 18 November 2026 at Steven Powell's direction, from its design proposal shared in the Everyday Cool ideas side chat: an interactive anatomical explorer (Whole Body → Organ System → Organ → Region/Structure → Function) — a front-view body atlas with twelve selectable organs across seven systems, a dedicated brain explorer (six tappable surface structures and twelve region topics, with the stated caveat that functions emerge from networks across regions), a connections mode ('Connect the dots — One body. Many systems.') following four everyday actions across cooperating organs, a six-question thinking check, and a screen-free educator activity; further-reading shelves of OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e (CC BY 4.0), Wikipedia, and NINDS material. ChatGPT committed the single self-contained page (all diagrams inline SVG; no external images, stylesheets, or scripts) directly to this repository as body/index.html, commit e1a9613. Integrated into the collection by Muse the same day: moved to projects/everyday-body/, house title and branding, banner added, Help menu and Help section added in the room's own idiom, house documentation files written — ChatGPT's script byte-identical and its content otherwise unaltered. This folder is the maintained original.
